title: Highly engaging workshop - Personal Efficiency
quote: This was truly an amazing workshop. The trainer was highly engaging and the sessions were interactive allowing all participants the chance to contribute and share their own experiences/examples. The course helped me to identify the potential causes of inefficiency as well as provide practical steps to develop action plans to develop personal efficiency. I highly recommend this training to anyone seeking to learn how to do things more efficiently and achieve long lasting results.
author: Adwoa Acquah
subject: Personal Efficiency
